candidates: When reviewing a PR that removes previously deprecated symbols or modules, verify that the deprecation was introduced in an already-shipped release, not one that is upcoming or imminent. If the removal would land in the same release as the deprecation, or a release is about to ship, request that the removal be deferred to a later release cycle.

Before approving, confirm that CI is passing. If CI failures appear to be caused by an external dependency that has since been updated (rather than by the MR's own changes), ask the author to rebase onto master or rerun the pipeline to confirm the failure is resolved prior to merge.
